title: 飯店入住
scene: 你晚上抵達飯店櫃檯辦入住。要報訂房、給證件、問清楚早餐時間地點、Wi-Fi、退房時間，還有行李能不能寄放。

lines.en: Good evening. Are you checking in?
lines.zh: 晚安，請問是要辦入住嗎？

lines.en: Yes, I have a reservation under Ho.
Let me find it. Two nights, one queen bed?
lines.zh: 我找一下。兩晚，一張大床？

lines.en: May I see your passport and a credit card?
lines.zh: 可以給我護照跟一張信用卡嗎？

lines.en: Thank you. Breakfast is included, seven to ten.
lines.zh: 謝謝。含早餐，七點到十點。

lines.en: On the second floor, next to the lobby.
Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
Yes, the password is on your key card.
Eleven, but we can hold your bags after that.
lines.zh: 十一點，不過之後可以幫您寄放行李。

lines.en: You're in room 512. The elevator is on your left.
lines.zh: 您的房間是 512。電梯在您左手邊。

vocab.example_en: I have a reservation under Chen.
I'll wait for you in the lobby.
The elevator is around the corner.
The gym is on the third floor.
Could you hold my bags until five?
vocab.example_zh: 可以幫我寄放行李到五點嗎？

vocab.example_en: Can we get an extra bed?

tips: 「我有訂房」講 I have a reservation under 加姓，不要說 I booked a room —— 那聽起來像在描述你以前做過的動作。
房號 512 唸「five twelve」，不是一個一個唸「five one two」。三位數房號都這樣唸。
寄放行李用 hold my bags 或 keep my luggage，不要用 save —— save 是「省下、拯救」。
checkout 連在一起是名詞（退房時間），check out 分開是動詞（辦退房）。問時間用名詞那個。
Wi-Fi 唸 /ˈwaɪ faɪ/，兩個音節都是長音，不要唸成「歪非」。
